top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Set to Rise on Tech, Yen Holds Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks looked set to rise after a rebound in chip shares fueled a Wall Street rally, reviving confidence in the artificial intelligence trade. The yen held onto its gains amid a report Japanese officials intervened to support the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
